translated_text: Mind precedes all mental states. Mind is their chief; they are all mind-made.
original_text: Manopubbaṅgamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā.

translated_text: If with an impure mind a person speaks or acts, suffering follows him like the wheel that follows the foot of the ox.
original_text: Manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā,

translated_text: If with an impure mind a person speaks or acts, suffering follows him like the wheel that follows the foot of the ox.
original_text: Tato naṃ dukhaṃ anveti, cakkaṃ va vahato padaṃ.

translated_text: If with a pure mind a person speaks or acts, happiness follows him like a shadow that never departs.
original_text: Manasā ce pasannena, bhāsati vā karoti vā,

translated_text: If with a pure mind a person speaks or acts, happiness follows him like a shadow that never departs.
original_text: Tato naṃ sukhaṃ anveti, chāyā va anapāyinī.

translated_text: He abused me, he struck me, he overpowered me, he robbed me. Those who harbor such thoughts do not still their hatred.
original_text: Akokila vajjaṃ katvā, bahumāniṃ niyojayī.

translated_text: He abused me, he struck me, he overpowered me, he robbed me. Those who do not harbor such thoughts still their hatred.
original_text: Attānaṃ upamaṃ katvā, hastisambhāraṃ vācaretā.

translated_text: Hatred is never appeased by hatred in this world. By non-hatred alone is hatred appeased. This is a law eternal.
original_text: Hiṃsā ca avihṃsā ca, dveme bhikkhu sambhavā.

translated_text: There are those who know that this is so, as well as those who know it. Let the wise person associate with the wise.
original_text: Sakkaccaṃ viññu paṭipajjeyya, medhāvī bahukhattuṃ.

translated_text: Thinking: 'This is mine,' a person indulges in pleasures. A householder does not discard attachments.
original_text: Dukkhaṃ iccheyya lokasmiṃ, yo nindā appaṭiggaho.

translated_text: Heedfulness is the path to the deathless. Heedlessness is the path to death. The heedful do not die. The heedless are already dead.
original_text: Appamādo tappano loke, bhayā hi maccuno raṭṭhato.

translated_text: Having understood this path of praise and blame, the wise one should practice so that he may be happy.
original_text: Vīriyavātipado dhammo, dhammo vīriyavātipado.

translated_text: Be heedful, resolute, and wise, cultivating the good. The one who is heedful gathers what is not heaped.
original_text: Yohave appamatto hoto, saddho viriyavā samāhito.

translated_text: The bhikkhu who delights in effort, who is steadfast in cultivation, who is resolute and strong, attains the supreme peace.
original_text: Vīriyānubhāvā jhāyī, ārambhe daḷhamānaso.

translated_text: Let the wise person establish himself in the practice of morality, concentration, and wisdom.
original_text: Tapassā brahmachariyā, saddhā sīlavisodhanaṃ.

translated_text: The bhikkhu who is virtuous, who delights in the teaching, and who is resolute, shines in this world like the moon freed from clouds.
original_text: Atha sikkhā ca sīlañca, sambhāvā bhikkhu dhammiko.

translated_text: The mind is hard to restrain, swift, it flies wherever it wishes. To tame the mind is good. A well-tamed mind brings happiness.
original_text: Cittasaṃyojanā dhammā, cittapavattiyā guṇā.

translated_text: Just as a fletcher makes straight an arrow, a wise person disciplines a mind that is wavering.
original_text: Cittasaṅkappamārāja, cetasā bahumānaso.

translated_text: Like a fish that has slipped from its watery abode, the mind escapes to the realm of Mara.
original_text: Daḷhaṃ nārāyano yottaṃ, dantā yāyanti tāvadā.

translated_text: The mind is very hard to see, very subtle, it flies wherever it wishes. The wise person should guard the mind, for a guarded mind brings happiness.
original_text: Cittamhi ce niyojeyya, bhāvanānurataṃ sataṃ.

translated_text: The mind, driven by mental defilements, is difficult to restrain, swift, and goes where it will.
original_text: Cittassa paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā.

translated_text: The mind is very hard to see, very subtle. The wise person protects the mind, for a protected mind brings happiness.
original_text: Cittāni bhūtāni, yāni anavasesāni, evaṃ passaṃ nappasajjeyya, honti bhikkhu na dubbacā.

translated_text: What is the use of your matted hair, ignorant man? What your torn garment? Within you is the tangle of passions.
original_text: Kiriyā hi dhammapuṇṇo ca, na tvaṃ kammavipākagā.

translated_text: You who wear the orange robe, what is the use of your matted hair? Within you is the tangle of passions.
original_text: Upakkilesā āyanti, na tvaṃ tapassī vihārase.

translated_text: He who has discarded passion in the world, who is calm, free from defilement, who has conquered himself, who has lived the good life.
original_text: Na muñcanti vinayantā, ye pi te āgatā vihāre.

translated_text: Let the wise person restrain himself from evil as a skilled horse-tamer subdues a bad horse.
original_text: Hiri ca ottappañca, dhūte sambhāvaye sato.

translated_text: The bhikkhu who is resolute, who delights in effort, who is steadfast and strong, attains the supreme peace.
original_text: Ārambhe daḷhamānaso, bhikkhu āraddhavīriyo.

translated_text: He who has abandoned vanity, who is free from conceit, who has cut off doubt, he is called a true bhikkhu.
original_text: Alīnehi tvaṃ pabbajjā, alīno hoti bhikkhu so.

translated_text: The Blessed One is a supremely awakened one, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, well-gone, a knower of the worlds.
original_text: Vijjācaraṇasampanno, sugato dhammadesako.

translated_text: The Blessed One is a supremely awakened one, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, well-gone, a knower of the worlds.
original_text: Vijjācaraṇasampanno, sugato dhammadesako.

translated_text: The Tathagata, the Worthy One, the Fully Self-Enlightened One.
original_text: Tathāgato arahaṃ, sammāsambuddho.

translated_text: He who is freed in this teaching, he truly finds happiness.
original_text: Yo imasmiṃ dhamme vimutto, sukhaṃ sodhāti.

translated_text: He who delights in morality, who is pure in mind, he attains the deathless.
original_text: Yo sīlesu samādahesi, cittaṃ vodānaṃ nāpāpuṇi.

translated_text: The fool who knows he is a fool has some intelligence. But the fool who thinks himself wise is truly a fool.
original_text: Aṇūpakāro satto'yanti, bālā niccaṃ anariya.

translated_text: If you find a person who points out your faults, follow him as you would a guide to hidden treasure.
original_text: Bālaṃ hīnena saṃyojeyya, tato naṃ vārameyya so.

translated_text: Let the wise person admonish, instruct, and dissuade from wrong. The well-wishing friend is hated by the wicked.
original_text: Saṃvāseti ca yo dhīro, vācāya madhurāya ca.

translated_text: Let not a fool keep company with you. Let no mean person befriend you. Let no one of low birth be intimate with you.
original_text: Bālā paggahitaṃ nāssu, mittadubbhassa narassa.

translated_text: Do not associate with fools. Associate with the wise. Pay homage to those worthy of homage.
original_text: Attānaṃ upamaṃ katvā, bālā saṃvāsaṃ na kappaye.

translated_text: The wise person who understands the Teaching of the Buddha, who lives a righteous life, is honored.
original_text: Paṇḍito sappuriso, buddhena sāsanaṃ

translated_text: The wise person who is steadfast, who speaks gently, not arrogantly, who teaches the Dhamma, is honored.
original_text: Dhīro ca paṭibalo ca, suvaco mattabhāṇī ca.

translated_text: A wise person should associate with the wise, not with the foolish. The wise person seeks the noble path.
original_text: Paṇḍitena payojetabbaṃ, na bālena kadācanaṃ.

translated_text: The wise person is resolute, knowing the Dhamma, speaking what is有益.
original_text: Paṇḍu paṭibalo dhīro, mattaññū vadaññū vā.

translated_text: The one who gives shelter to many, who is a refuge for many, who benefits many.
original_text: Saṅgahaṃ vata kattāraṃ, mahantaṃ bhattuṃ vā pugaṃ.

translated_text: The Arahants are free from defilements, freed from the cycle of rebirth.
original_text: Khīṇāsavā arahanto, khīṇā jātivuṭṭhatā.

translated_text: For one who constantly honors and serves those who are worthy, four benefits increase: long life, beauty, happiness, and strength.
original_text: Abhivādanasīlissa, niccaṃ vuḍḍhāpacāyino.

translated_text: Nibbana is the supreme peace. The holy life is the best. The one who has realized the truth is the best among people.
original_text: Khemaṃ nibbānaṃ saccaṃ, santapāsaṃ abhikkantaṃ.

translated_text: The noble one, the peaceful one, who has abandoned passion, who is heedful, who sees clearly.
original_text: Ariyo santo pahāso, appamatto vipassako.

translated_text: He who is learned and who has acquired great knowledge, he is indeed wise.
original_text: Yo have bahussuto hoti, laddhā kevalapaccaṃ.

translated_text: The heedful person who sees the danger in the smallest fault does not fall into greater evil.
original_text: Appamatto vipassako, so pi bhiyyō na jāyati.

translated_text: Though one may conquer a thousand times a thousand men in battle, yet he indeed is the noblest victor who conquers himself.
original_text: Sahassā sahassanena, sattahi maccujiyhasehi.

translated_text: Self-conquest is better than the conquest of others. The one who has conquered himself is a noble person.
original_text: Attānaṃ jeyya paṇḍito, attānaṃ vata tādiso.

translated_text: Even if the entire world is covered with treasure, one moment of meditation is worth more.
original_text: Cakkavāḷe sannibbhante, nagassa nibbhogepi ca.

translated_text: He who lives in the Dhamma, who delights in the Dhamma, meditates on the Dhamma, he does not decline.
original_text: Yo sīlesu samādahesi, dhammamajjhena bhāvitam.

translated_text: The bhikkhu who walks the good path, who is established in the Dhamma.
original_text: Kaṇhassa suppaṭipanno, bhikkhu dhammamajjhagato.

translated_text: First he follows the Teacher's dispensation, then he serves the good.
original_text: Paṭhamaṃ satthu sāsane, dutiyaṃ vata sevake.

translated_text: The wise person bears the teaching, while the evil do not.
original_text: Tatiyaṃ dhīro dhārayati, catutthaṃ vata pāpagā.

translated_text: Not doing evil is better than doing it. Not suffering is better than suffering.
original_text: Akataṃ dukkataṃ seyyo, yañca kiñcī karīyati.

translated_text: Evil is easy to do, but harmful to oneself. The good is difficult to do, but leads to happiness.
original_text: Sukaro dukkataṃ kātuṃ, atha pāpānipātayituṃ.

translated_text: All tremble at the rod. All fear death. Comparing others with oneself, one should neither kill nor cause others to kill.
original_text: Sabbe tasanti daṇḍassa, sabbe bhāyanti maraṇato.

translated_text: All tremble at the rod. All hold their lives dear. Comparing others with oneself, one should neither kill nor cause others to kill.
original_text: Sabbe tasanti daṇḍassa, sabbesaṃ jīvitaṃ piyaṃ.

translated_text: If one can protect oneself, one should also protect others. The wise person disciplines himself.
original_text: Attānaṃ ce tārayanti, atha parānampi tāraye.

translated_text: He who injures is not a noble person. He who does not injure is a noble person.
original_text: Yo haneyya na hāpeti, yo ca haneyya na hāpeti.

translated_text: Listen to the Dhamma, warriors. The Dhamma I shall teach.
original_text: Suṇohi dhammaṃ vāresco, yaṃ te kathayissāmi.

translated_text: What laughter, what joy, when the world is always burning? Why are you not seeking light when darkness has come?
original_text: Ko nu hāso yamassatthaṃ, yamamajjhe ṭhitassa nūna.

translated_text: Look upon the world as a bubble. Look upon it as a mirage. The king of death does not see the person who looks upon the world thus.
original_text: Attānaṃ avekkhassa, niccaṃ gāmassataṃ muniṃ.

translated_text: Beautiful in form, endowed with great wealth, yet when old age comes, the fool is overcome.
original_text: Vaṇṇupeto vaṇṇavāpi, atho pīṇitamukhariyo.

translated_text: Old age and death are seen both here and in the future. Having understood this, the wise person should purify himself.
original_text: Jarā ca maraṇaṃ cāpi, idhāpi pecca vijjati.

translated_text: Be islands unto yourselves, be refuges unto yourselves, with no other refuge. Let the Dhamma be your island, let the Dhamma be your refuge, with no other refuge.
original_text: Attadīpā viharatha, attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā.

translated_text: Let the Dhamma be your island, let the Dhamma be your refuge, with no other refuge.
original_text: Dhammadīpā viharatha, dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā.

translated_text: With heedfulness and clear comprehension, the wise person cuts off the fetters.
original_text: Ātāpino sampajāno, satimā vincināti bandhanaṃ.

translated_text: Oneself is one's own protector. Who else could be the protector?
original_text: Attā hi attano nātho, ko hi nātho paro siyā.

translated_text: By oneself is evil done; by oneself is it defiled. By oneself is it left undone; by oneself is one purified. Purity and impurity depend on oneself.
original_text: Attanā hi kataṃ pāpaṃ, attajaṃ attasambhavaṃ.

translated_text: Impermanent are all conditioned things. Arising and ceasing is their nature. Born, they cease, their calming is bliss.
original_text: Aniccā vata saṅkhārā, uppādaya vayaṃ aniccaṃ.

translated_text: In the bhikkhu who is concentrated, wisdom shines.
original_text: Yamhi bhikkhu samādho ca, ñāṇaṃ cāpi virocate.

translated_text: The Buddhas teach for a purpose, not for mere eating.
original_text: Atthāya buddhā desenti, no apiṭṭhāya piṇḍake.

translated_text: Therefore the wise person is content, with few wishes, seeking happiness.
original_text: Tasmā hi dhīro appiccho, santuṭṭho hitena saṃ.

translated_text: This was said by the Blessed One for the benefit of those with few wishes.
original_text: Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā, appicchānaṃ hitāya.

translated_text: Whatever is established in the world, that is the nature of things.
original_text: Lokamhi yañca paññattaṃ, dhammataṃ vata tādisaṃ.

translated_text: The Blessed One is accomplished, the teaching is well-taught, the Sangha is well-practiced.
original_text: Sampanno sugato dhammo, suppaṭipanno bhikkhasaṅgho.

translated_text: The Blessed One is a Fully Self-Enlightened One.
original_text: Buddho bhagavā, sammāsambuddho.

translated_text: Accomplished in knowledge and conduct, well-gone, a knower of the worlds.
original_text: Vijjācaraṇasampanno, sugato lokavidū.

translated_text: Unsurpassed trainer of persons, teacher of gods and humans.
original_text: Anuttaro purisadammasārathī, satthā devamanussānaṃ.

translated_text: I believe the Blessed One is a Buddha. The Blessed One is worthy.
original_text: Buddho bhagavā ti maññāmi, bhagavā hi arahamabhi.

translated_text: Health is the greatest wealth. Contentment is the greatest treasure.
original_text: Arogyā paramā lābhā, santuṭṭhī paramaṃ dhanaṃ.

translated_text: Even in battle, the sight of a peaceful person is supreme.
original_text: Vacchagatto pi saṅgāme, coraṃ yānañca dassanaṃ.

translated_text: Happy is the arising of the Buddhas. Happy is the teaching of the Dhamma.
original_text: Sukho buddhānauppādo, sukhā saddhammadesanā.

translated_text: Happy is the unity of the Sangha. Happy is the discipline of the unified.
original_text: Sukho saṅghassa samaggo, samaggānaṃ tapo sukho.

translated_text: The wise person who hears the Buddha's teaching, the Dhamma that leads to the deathless.
original_text: Dhīro sutavā buddhassa, saddhammaṃ vijjācariyaṃ.

translated_text: Even one who is lowly is dear to the one who is dear to him. The Dhamma is not dear when it is not practiced.
original_text: Piyo pi vattarī hīno, yo pi vattarī piyo.

translated_text: The dear friend who is wise, the knowledgeable one who is not too far.
original_text: Piyo vattarī medhāvī, viññū nātidūrato.

translated_text: Affection is the root of suffering. Detachment is the root of happiness.
original_text: Piyo dukkhassa mūlaṃ, bhīyo dukkhassa mūlaṃ.

translated_text: He who has attained enlightenment through happiness, but is born again in suffering.
original_text: Sukhito bodhipatto pi, dukkhe jāti punappunaṃ.

translated_text: Abandon anger, give up conceit. Surrender all fetters. The person who is free from all mental defilements is not tormented.
original_text: Kodhaṃ jahi na te hoti, pāpaṃ appaccayaṃ vade.

translated_text: One who knows anger, who abandons anger, who is freed from anger, is a true bhikkhu.
original_text: Yo kho kuddhaṃ pajānāti, hitvā kodhaṃ visujjhati.

translated_text: The patient, the forgiver, the gentle, the bhikkhu who speaks the Dhamma.
original_text: Khama vāpasu dāntā ca, santo ca bhikkhu bhasati.

translated_text: Anger leads to evil. Anger defiles the mind. The wise person abandons anger.
original_text: Kodhā jahati pāpassa, kodho cittassa dūsano.

translated_text: The wind blows away defilements as the wind blows away debris.
original_text: Malaṃ dhunāti vātasso, udakaṃ vātasaṃhitaṃ.

translated_text: Even the good person who is defiled does not speak or act evil intentionally.
original_text: Supo pi na sarā pāpaṃ, bhāsate vā karoti vā.

translated_text: If one could refrain from evil, one would be pure.
original_text: Yaṃ karaṃ na kiliseyya, pasādānaṃ bhavesi ce.

translated_text: Like the Maluva vine that envelops a tree, attachment leads to suffering.
original_text: Māluvaṃ viṭapiṃ gantvā, yathā nābhibhave sataṃ.

translated_text: Like the Maluva vine that envelops a tree, attachment leads to suffering.
original_text: Māluvaṃ viṭapiṃ gantvā, yathā nābhibhave sataṃ.

translated_text: As long as one lives, one should cultivate the good.
original_text: Attānaṃ jīvitaṃ yāva, etaṃ kho sādhu maññeyya.

translated_text: The bhikkhu who is established in the Dhamma, who is resolute, who delights in the teaching.
original_text: Kāyappasākho bhikkhuno, saddhā meghānusārinī.

translated_text: The bhikkhu who is established in morality, who grows through the Dhamma.
original_text: Yo paṭhamaṃ sīlesu, tato vuddhānubhāvato.

translated_text: The bhikkhu who is skilled in conduct, who delights in practice.
original_text: Ācārakusalo bhikkhu, paṭipattisukhānugo.

translated_text: The tamed bhikkhu moves among the untamed without fear.
original_text: Dantā yanti pavattamānā, na bhāyanti upassutā.

translated_text: Having entered the Dhamma, one should practice heedfully.
original_text: Dhammāyatanamāgamma, paṭipajjeyya tappanaṃ.

translated_text: The four foundations of mindfulness, taught by the Fully Self-Enlightened One.
original_text: Satipaṭṭhānavīriyā, sammāsambuddhadesitā.

translated_text: The bhikkhu who practices, who is clear-comprehending and mindful.
original_text: Ārādhako bhikkhu tassa, sampajāno satīmā.

translated_text: The one who practices morality grows through the teaching.
original_text: Yo paṭhamaṃ sīlesu, tato vuddhānubhāvato.

translated_text: The one who follows the Dhamma grows through the teaching.
original_text: Yo dhammapaṭipanno, tato vuddhānubhāvato.

translated_text: The one who practices the Dhamma grows through the teaching.
original_text: Attho hi dhamme paṭipanno, vuddhānubhāvato.

translated_text: The Pacceka Buddhas are free from passion, having attained Nibbana.
original_text: Paccekabuddhā vītarāgā, nibbānādhigamā narā.

translated_text: The Brahmin who is free from passion is indeed a true Brahmin.
original_text: Anussatībhūto hoti, vītatto brāhmaṇo tathā.

translated_text: The one who has realized the truth is called a true Brahmin.
original_text: Brahmā hi brāhmaṇo tassa, taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tathā viduṃ.

translated_text: The one who knows all things is called a true Brahmin.
original_text: Yo sabbadhammaṃ pajānāti, tathā brāhmaṇaṃ pavuccati.

translated_text: A true Brahmin is not born. He becomes a Brahmin through his actions.
original_text: Brāhmaṇo nāma khattiyo, brāhmaṇo nopapajjati.

translated_text: Purity does not come from external observances. The one who is pure in mind is the true pure one.
original_text: Nālaṃ suddhī pānena, na suddhī suddhikāraṇā.

translated_text: As the bamboo stands firm, so should one stand in the Dhamma.
original_text: Kaṭṭho yathā daddaraṃ yāti, evaṃ dhammo anuddharī.

translated_text: Having cut off all attachments, the noble one is truly liberated.
original_text: Sabbaṃ āvāhanaṃ chetvā, anāsī vata te guṇā.

translated_text: Having cut off the five hindrances, the bhikkhu attains the fruits of stream-entry.
original_text: Chetvā nīvaraṇe satta, sotāpatti phalāni ca.

translated_text: Both the fool and the wise enter the village alike. But the wise person is respected.
original_text: Bālo ca paṇḍito ca, tulyaṃ gacchanti gāmikā.

translated_text: The bhikkhu who is resolute, who delights in effort, attains the supreme peace.
original_text: Ārambhe daḷhamānaso, bhikkhu āraddhavīriyo.

translated_text: My restless mind runs like an antelope. Let me calm it like an antelope hunter calms his prey.
original_text: Erraṃ vata me sāratto, erraṃ cittaṃ nigacchati.

translated_text: My restless mind runs like an antelope. Let me calm it.
original_text: Erraṃ vata me sāratto, erraṃ cittaṃ nigacchati.

translated_text: The wise person, with a peaceful mind, abandons fear and terror.
original_text: Asantāsaṃ bhayaṃ hitvā, santacittena paṇḍitā.

translated_text: The wise person who follows the Buddha's teaching.
original_text: Paṇḍito sappuriso, buddhena sāsanaṃ.

translated_text: The wise and good person who follows the Buddha's teaching.
original_text: Yo dhīro sappuriso, buddhena sāsanaṃ.

translated_text: The one who is honored by the two, who follows the Buddha's teaching.
original_text: Yo ca duve dhamme pūjito, buddhena sāsanaṃ.

translated_text: The one who is honored by the two, who follows the Buddha's teaching.
original_text: Yo ca duve dhamme pūjito, buddhena sāsanaṃ.

translated_text: The Brahmin who has penetrated the fetters, they say is truly liberated.
original_text: Tañca bandhanamajjhagato, tassa muñcanti brāhmaṇā.

translated_text: The wise and good person who follows the Buddha's teaching.
original_text: Yo dhīro sappuriso, buddhena sāsanaṃ.

translated_text: The one who knows all things is called a true Brahmin.
original_text: Yo sabbadhammaṃ pajānāti, tathā brāhmaṇaṃ pavuccati.

translated_text: The wise and good person who follows the Buddha's teaching.
original_text: Yo dhīro sappuriso, buddhena sāsanaṃ.

translated_text: The wise and good person who follows the Buddha's teaching.
original_text: Yo dhīro sappuriso, buddhena sāsanaṃ.

translated_text: The wise and good person who follows the Buddha's teaching.
original_text: Yo dhīro sappuriso, buddhena sāsanaṃ.

translated_text: The one who has realized the truth is called a true Brahmin.
original_text: Brahmā hi brāhmaṇo tassa, taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tathā viduṃ.

translated_text: The one who knows all things is called a true Brahmin.
original_text: Yo sabbadhammaṃ pajānāti, tathā brāhmaṇaṃ pavuccati.

translated_text: He who delights in morality, who is pure in mind, attains the deathless.
original_text: Yo sīlesu samādahesi, cittaṃ vodānaṃ nāpāpuṇi.

translated_text: The bhikkhu who is established in morality, who grows through the Dhamma.
original_text: Yo paṭhamaṃ sīlesu, tato vuddhānubhāvato.

translated_text: The bhikkhu who is skilled in conduct, who delights in practice.
original_text: Ācārakusalo bhikkhu, paṭipattisukhānugo.

translated_text: The one who follows the Dhamma grows through the teaching.
original_text: Yo dhammapaṭipanno, tato vuddhānubhāvato.

translated_text: The one who practices the Dhamma grows through the teaching.
original_text: Attho hi dhamme paṭipanno, vuddhānubhāvato.

translated_text: The bhikkhu who practices the Dhamma grows through the teaching.
original_text: Dhammapaṭipanno bhikkhu, vuddhānubhāvato.

translated_text: Thus have I heard: At one time the Blessed One was dwelling on Vulture Peak near Rajagriha.
original_text: evam me sutaṃ — ekasmin samaye bhagavān vulture peak mountain pārsva parivartamāno.

translated_text: Gone, gone, gone beyond, gone completely beyond. Enlightenment! So be it!
original_text: tadyathā — gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā.

translated_text: The noble Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, while practicing the profound Prajna Paramita.
original_text: āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ caryāṃ caramāṇo.

translated_text: He clearly saw that the five skandhas are empty of inherent nature.
original_text: vyavalokayati sma pañca skandhās tāṃś ca svabhāva śūnyān paśyati sma.

translated_text: Here, Shariputra, form is emptiness, and emptiness is form.
original_text: iha Śāriputra rūpaṃ śūnyatā śūnyataiva rūpam.

translated_text: Form is not separate from emptiness, emptiness is not separate from form.
original_text: rūpān na pṛthak śūnyatā śūnyatāyā na pṛthag rūpam.

translated_text: Whatever is form, that is emptiness; whatever is emptiness, that is form.
original_text: yad rūpaṃ sā śūnyatā yā śūnyatā tad rūpam.

translated_text: The same is true of feelings, perceptions, mental formations, and consciousness.
original_text: evam eva vedanā saṃjñā saṃskārā vijñānāni.

translated_text: Here, Shariputra, all dharmas are marked with emptiness.
original_text: iha Śāriputra sarvadharmāḥ śūnyatā lakṣaṇāḥ.

translated_text: They are not produced, not ceased, not pure, not impure, neither increasing nor decreasing.
original_text: anutpannā aniruddhā amalā avimalā nonā raktāḥ.

translated_text: Therefore in emptiness there is no form, no feeling, no perception, no mental formations, no consciousness.
original_text: tasmāc chūnyatāyāṃ na rūpaṃ na vedanā na saṃjñā na saṃskārā na vijñānam.

translated_text: No eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, mind.
original_text: na cakṣur-śrotra-ghrāṇa-jihvā-kāya-manāṃsi.

translated_text: No form, sound, smell, taste, touch, or dharmas.
original_text: na rūpa-śabda-gandha-rasa-sparśa-dharmāḥ.

translated_text: No eye-element up to no mind-element.
original_text: na cakṣur-dhātur yāvam na mano-dhātuḥ.

translated_text: No ignorance and no extinction of ignorance, up to no aging and death and no extinction of aging and death.
original_text: na avidyā na avidyā-kṣayo yāvam na jarā-maraṇaṃ na jarā-maraṇa-kṣayaḥ.

translated_text: No suffering, origination, cessation, path; no wisdom, no attainment.
original_text: na duḥkha-samudaya-nirodha-mārgā na jñānaṃ na prāptiḥ.

translated_text: Relying on Prajna Paramita, the bodhisattvas have no obscuration of mind.
original_text: anāptitvād bodhisattvānāṃ prajñāpāramitām āśritya.

translated_text: Free from obscuration, they have no fear. Far from the twisted views of samsara.
original_text: virāgānām asamkliṣṭā jñānaṃ pratya vandayati.

translated_text: They attain the supreme perfect enlightenment.
original_text: nirvāṇaṃ prāpya samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃbuddhāḥ.

translated_text: Therefore know that Prajna Paramita is the great mantra.
original_text: tasmāj jñātavyaṃ prajñāpāramitā mahāmantrā.

translated_text: The great mantra of knowledge, the unsurpassed mantra, the unequalled mantra.
original_text: mahāvidyāmantrā anuttaramantrā asamasamamantrāḥ.

translated_text: It removes all suffering. It is true, not false.
original_text: sarva-duḥkha-praśamanaḥ satyam amithyatvād.

translated_text: Therefore set forth the Prajna Paramita mantra, set forth the mantra, and say: Gone, gone, gone beyond, gone completely beyond. Enlightenment! So be it!
original_text: prajñāpāramitāyām ukto mantrāḥ tadyathā gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā.

translated_text: For the benefit of all sentient beings and for the perfection of karma.
original_text: pūrva-karma paramparā siddhyarthaṃ sarva-sattvānāṃ kuśalāya.

translated_text: Prajna Paramita is revered by all blessed Buddhas.
original_text: prajñāpāramitā parityaktāḥ sarva-buddhair bhagavadbhiḥ.

translated_text: Therefore Prajna Paramita is most worthy of worship.
original_text: tasmāt prajñāpāramitā pūjyaṭamā.

translated_text: The cessation of all suffering and the source of all happiness.
original_text: sarvaduhkha-nirodha-kāraṇaṃ sarva-sukha-sampad-uddeśakaṃ.

translated_text: There is no other refuge, there is no other shelter.
original_text: nāsty anyā parā gatir anyā parā śaraṇam.

translated_text: All Buddhas and Bodhisattvas take refuge in Prajna Paramita.
original_text: sarva-buddha-bodhisattvāḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ niśritāḥ.

translated_text: May all beings be happy and safe. May all beings have happy minds.
original_text: Sukhino vā khemino hontu, sabbe sattā bhavantu sukhitattā.

translated_text: Whatever living beings there may be, without exception — feeble or strong, long, stout, or of middle size.
original_text: Ye keci pāṇa bhūtattā, tasā vā thāvarā vā anavasesā.

translated_text: The seen and the unseen, those living near and those far away.
original_text: Diṭṭhā vā yadi vā adiṭṭhā, ye vā dūre vasanti avidūre.

translated_text: Those already born and those yet to be born, may all beings have happy minds.
original_text: Bhūtā vā sambhavesī vā, sabbe sattā bhavantu sukhitattā.

translated_text: Let no one deceive another, nor despise anyone anywhere.
original_text: Nāparo parassa kattā, mānaṃ annassa kappaye.

translated_text: Do not wish pain for another through anger or ill-will.
original_text: Mā vihiṃsāññatassaññassa, dukkhī dukkhānubhāvetu.

translated_text: Just as a mother would protect her only child at the risk of her own life.
original_text: Mātā yathā niyaṃ puttaṃ, āyusā ekaputtamanurakkhe.

translated_text: Even so, one should cultivate a boundless heart towards all beings.
original_text: Evampi sabhabhūtesu, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ.

translated_text: Compassion for the entire world, a boundless heart of loving-kindness.
original_text: Mettañca sabbalokasmiṃ, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ.

translated_text: Standing, walking, sitting, or lying down — as long as one is awake, one should develop this mindfulness.
original_text: Uddhaṃ adho ca tiriyañca, asambādhaṃ averaṃ asapattaṃ.

translated_text: The practice of meditation, the cultivation of insight.
original_text: Diṭṭhānussativikkhambhitaṃ, sambhāricaṃ vipassinaṃ.

translated_text: Those who have attained Nibbana, who are free from defilements.
original_text: Dissanti pure vā cāpi, nibbānādhigamā pajā.

translated_text: Not to associate with fools, but to associate with the wise.
original_text: Asevato sappurise, nāstike vā sahāsatā.

translated_text: To honor those worthy of honor, and to accept gifts in due measure.
original_text: Pūjā pūjaniyesu, paṭiggāho yathārahaṃ.

translated_text: The noble person who is wise and strong.
original_text: Uttamapuriso hoti, yo ca dhīro paṭibalo.

translated_text: The learned, the knowledgeable, the wise, and the good.
original_text: Sutavā ca bahussuto, paṇḍito sappuriso ca.

translated_text: The one who loves the Dhamma, who teaches the Dhamma.
original_text: Dhammakāmo sugavejjho, satthā dhammaṃ vadesu no.

translated_text: The one who practices the Dhamma with faith, who increases wisdom.
original_text: Dhammaṃ carati saddhā, ñāṇaṃ vaddheti paṇḍito.

translated_text: The one who is virtuous, who practices the good Dhamma, who does not despise donors.
original_text: Sīlavā ca kalyāṇadhammo, nātimaññati dāninaṃ.

translated_text: Generosity, righteous conduct, and caring for parents.
original_text: Dānaṃ ca dhammacariyā ca, mātāpitū upaṭṭhānaṃ.

translated_text: Good friendship, morality, self-restraint, and non-violence.
original_text: Kalyāṇamittatā sīlaṃ, sappamāṇaṃ asañcataṃ.

translated_text: Asceticism, the holy life, truth, and always self-restraint.
original_text: Tapo brahmachariyaṃ saccā, saṃyamāni ca sabbadā.

translated_text: Loving-kindness for the entire world, a boundless heart.
original_text: Mettaṃ ca sabbalokasmiṃ, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ.

translated_text: The sight of Nibbana, not touching desire.
original_text: Dassanāni ca nibbānaṃ, na kāmaṃ phusate pare.

translated_text: This is the highest blessing.
original_text: Etaṃ mangalamuttamaṃ.

translated_text: Those things taught by the Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Well-Gone.
original_text: Yāni sambuddhena desitāni, cakkhumānena sugatena bahunā.

translated_text: The Buddha, the Dhamma, and the Sangha — these three treasures.
original_text: Buddho dhammo saṅgho ca, tisso ratanānugārahī.

translated_text: And those that lead to Nibbana, taught by the Well-Gone One.
original_text: Ye ca nibbānagāmino, dhammā sugata desitā.

translated_text: Blessed are the accomplished ones, who honor the three treasures.
original_text: Sādhu te sādhu sampannā, tisso ratanānugārahī.

translated_text: Do not go by oral tradition, by lineage of teaching, or by hearsay.
original_text: Mā anussavena, mā paramparāya, mā piṭakasampadānena.

translated_text: Do not go by logical reasoning, by inferential reasoning, or by reasoned cogitation.
original_text: Mā takkahetu, mā nayahetu, mā pikappakappanāya.

translated_text: Do not go by the view that the ascetic is our teacher.
original_text: Mā bhabbarūpatāya, mā samaṇo no garūti.

translated_text: When you know for yourselves: 'These things are unwholesome.'
original_text: Yadā tumhe attanā yeva jāneyyātha — ime dhammā akusalā.

translated_text: Abandon them.
original_text: Kusalā ti, tāni pajahatha.

translated_text: When you know for yourselves: 'These things are wholesome.'
original_text: Yadā tumhe attanā yeva jāneyyātha — ime dhammā kusalā.

translated_text: Develop them.
original_text: Kusalā ti tāni bhāvetha.

translated_text: In the seen there will be merely the seen. In the heard there will be merely the heard.
original_text: Diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati.

translated_text: In the sensed there will be merely the sensed. In the cognized there will be merely the cognized.
original_text: Mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati.

translated_text: When this is not there, you are not that.
original_text: Tatra tvaṃ na tena.

translated_text: When you are not that, then you are not that.
original_text: Yadā tatra tvaṃ na tena, tadā tatra tvaṃ na tasmiṃ.

translated_text: When you are not that, then you are not here, not there, nor between the two.
original_text: Yadā tatra tvaṃ na tasmiṃ, tadā tatra tvaṃ nevidha na huraṃ na ubhayamantarena.

translated_text: This is the end of suffering.
original_text: Es' ev' anto dukkhassa.

translated_text: All this, monks, is burning.
original_text: Sabbam pi idaṃ bhikkhave ādittaṃ.

translated_text: The eye is burning, forms are burning, eye-consciousness is burning.
original_text: Cakkhu ādittaṃ, rūpā ādittā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ.

translated_text: Eye-contact is burning.
original_text: Cakkhusamphasso āditto.

translated_text: Whatever feeling arises from eye-contact, that too is burning.
original_text: Yam pi cakkhusamphassapaccayā vedanā, sā pi ādittā.

translated_text: The ear is burning, sounds are burning, ear-consciousness is burning.
original_text: Sotaṃ ādittaṃ, saddā ādittā, sotaviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ.

translated_text: The nose is burning, odors are burning, nose-consciousness is burning.
original_text: Ghānaṃ ādittaṃ, gandhā ādittā, ghanaviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ.

translated_text: The tongue is burning, tastes are burning, tongue-consciousness is burning.
original_text: Jivhā ādittā, rasā ādittā, jivhāviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ.

translated_text: The body is burning, tangibles are burning, body-consciousness is burning.
original_text: Kāyo āditto, phassā ādittā, kayaviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ.

translated_text: The mind is burning, mental objects are burning, mind-consciousness is burning.
original_text: Mano āditto, dhammā ādittā, manoviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ.

translated_text: Eye-consciousness is burning, feeling is burning, mental formations are burning.
original_text: Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ, vedanā ādittā, saṅkhārā ādittā.

translated_text: All this is burning.
original_text: Sabbam pi idaṃ ādittaṃ.

translated_text: When this is understood and practiced, the burning consciousness becomes quenched.
original_text: Evan ca hoti evaṃ paṭipajjato, ādittaṃ viññāṇaṃ nibbutaṃ hoti.

translated_text: Impermanent are all conditioned things. Arising and ceasing is their nature.
original_text: Aniccā vata saṅkhārā, uppādaya vayaṃ aniccaṃ.

translated_text: Born, they cease, their calming is bliss.
original_text: Uppajjitvā nirujjhanti, tesaṃ vūpasamo sukho.

translated_text: Strive on with diligence.
original_text: Appamādena sampādetha.

translated_text: All conditioned things are of a nature to decay. Strive on with diligence.
original_text: Vayadhammā saṅkhārā, appamādena sampādethāti.

translated_text: And now, monks, I address you.
original_text: Handa dāni bhikkhave āmantayāmi.

translated_text: All conditioned things are of a nature to decay. Strive on with diligence.
original_text: Vayadhammā saṅkhārā, appamādena sampādetha.
